title: Marsh launches Cyber Aviation, a cyber insurance form for airlines
summary: Marsh announced Cyber Aviation, an aviation-specific cyber insurance form for global airlines, according to Insurance Journal and Reinsurance News. It covers first- and third-party exposures such as network interruption, data and privacy liability, regulatory response and cyber extortion. It can be paired with Marsh's Cyber ECHO excess facility, which offers up to $200 million of follow-form capacity.
plain: Insurance broker Marsh has launched a cyber insurance form for airlines. Reports say it can be paired with an excess facility offering up to $200 million of follow-form capacity.
exec: Marsh has launched cyber insurance designed for airlines; an excess facility offers up to $200 million of follow-form capacity.
